svg.text: 1× WeAct Blackpill STM32F411CEU6 driving 2× SimpleFOC Shield v2.0.4 + 2× AS5047P (per BOM.csv). Pins are grouped by function, not physical header order.
drives M0 · pads: A=D10 B=D5 C=D6 EN=D8
drives M1 · pads: A=D9 B=D3 C=D11 EN=D7
LM7808 regulator pad OPEN on both shields —
do NOT wire shield VIN / 5V to the Blackpill
1. Shields are jumper-wired to the Blackpill (they don't plug into it). Bridge the PWM/EN pads listed on each shield; leave the LM7808 regulator pad open.
2. One common ground: PSU −, both shield GNDs, Blackpill GND, both AS5047P GNDs and the pot. Every 3V3/GND flag ties to the Blackpill 3V3/GND pins.
3. Power the Blackpill from USB only. Never connect a shield's VIN or 5V pin to it — VIN carries 8 V when the regulator pad is bridged.
4. Current sense (shield A0–A3) is unused by the voltage-mode torque loop — leave it unconnected. If added later: ADC-range pad = 3.3 V, and use spare ADC pins PA1, PA2, PA3, PB0.
5. Motor phase order a/b/c doesn't matter: initFOC() finds direction and electrical zero. Keep SPI leads short (≤ 20 cm), each twisted with a GND.
6. SW1 cuts 12 V to both shields — keep it in reach as a kill switch for the stick.
7. The firmware in firmware/ still targets the earlier B-G431B-ESC1 + UART design; it needs porting to this single-MCU pin map.
